content: ˚न्यायः the rule according to which when an act ({%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} दर्शपूर्णमास) is said to yield all desired objects, what is meant is that it can yield them only one at a time and not all simultaneously. This is established by जैमिनि and शबर in <ls>MS. 4. 3. 27-28</ls>. Thus for the achievement of each separate काम, a separate performance of the याग is necessary; (see दर्शपूर्णमासन्याय).
